messages:
Yara: opened PR to modernize the hello-lighthouse quickstart (auth snippets + first deploy + tiny migration note). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1588 — need a quick review on node/python snippets and the docker example.
Devon: taking a look. Node sample still uses `REDWOOD_TOKEN` in one spot. we standardized on `REDWOOD_API_KEY` last cycle — can you switch?
Mina: also the Node example calls `client.call()`; for clarity with SDK v6+ we should use `client.generate()` everywhere.
Yara: good catches, will update both. FYI the docker run example forgot to map ports; CI preview couldn't reach the app in staging.
ci-bot: CI: link-checker flagged a broken anchor on deploy.md -> ./deploy.md#expose-port (404).
Devon: that anchor got renamed in last docs PR. i'll add an alias header back to avoid 404s and update cross-links.
Mina: small lint: the README code fence is labeled `js` but contains TS syntax (type annotations). switch to `typescript` or remove types for the minimal quickstart.
Yara: removed types and standardized fences. pushed a commit to the branch.
Devon: pushed anchor alias and replaced `REDWOOD_TOKEN` with `REDWOOD_API_KEY` in all snippets. also changed `client.call()` -> `client.generate()` in the node example.
ci-bot: CI: tests failed on commit a1b2c3 — lint error (old fence labels).
Yara: fixed fence labels, pushed commit a1b2c4.
preview-bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-1588--docs.redwood-ai.com/quickstarts/hello-lighthouse — smoke checks passed.
docs-bot: link-checker: no broken links detected in preview. spellcheck: suggested "Lighthouse" capitalization for header.
Mina: added a one-line migration note at the top: "If you used REDWOOD_TOKEN or client.call previously, switch to REDWOOD_API_KEY and client.generate() — see migration guide."
Yara: added a short note under "Deploy locally" with explicit Docker run: `docker run -p 8080:8080 hello-lighthouse` and EXPOSE 8080 in Dockerfile. also added HEALTHCHECK to reduce flakiness.
Devon: :thumbsup: I also added a tiny FAQ entry for "Why is my sample output different?" — explain outputs vary unless seed is set.
Yara: planning to merge once CI stays green and then tag a docs patch release. ETA ~20m.
Mina: Action items after merge: update changelog, run full site link sweep, and open a redirect PR for any external blog links pointing to the old anchor.
Yara: thanks all — merging when green. :rocket:

---

Snippet (Node) from PR:
```js
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'lighthouse-mini', prompt: 'describe a cozy lighthouse' });
console.log(resp.text);
```

Deploy note added in doc: `docker run -p 8080:8080 hello-lighthouse`

Action items: Yara - merge & tag release; Devon - follow-up redirect PR if external 404s; Mina - run post-merge link sweep."
